t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup styled as an engineering drawing sheet on deep navy. A double steel-blue border carries zone-reference letters and numbers and small centring arrows. Inside, a very large light-weight sans headline and light subhead, then a fully boxed monospace table of <CONTENT> with a bold mono header row and steel-blue hairline cells. A small outlined tab label sits on the table's top-right edge; an empty title block fills the bottom-right corner. Off-white text, flat, square corners, no shadows.
signature_idea: The table wears a folder-style tab label inside a zone-bordered drawing sheet, like a sheet pulled from a document set.
strengths: clean, legible table; easy to build
zone band with centring arrows is a convincing drawing-sheet frame
palette is strictly navy, off-white and steel-blue
light headline and mono cells fit the type system
weaknesses: plain table only, no visual idea beyond the frame
title block is empty; no AQ-CQ-001 code as asked
no row numbers; full boxed grid is heavier than hairline rules
headline repeats the page name, section title demoted to a tab
invented responsibility values repeat 'Aquemi' and 'Your validation team' almost everywhere
brand_fit_why: On-palette and square with light headline and mono cells, but it is a plain boxed table that misses the title-block code and numbered rows.
